title: Mail Operation Cancel Permission Consistency

items.action: expose and invoke executable mail operation actions including cancel

database.reason: No persistence model changes are introduced.

migration.reason: Existing mail send execute permission is reused.

backend.reason: No backend cancellation endpoint or authorization behavior is changed.

tenant_isolation.reason: Existing organization-scoped mail operation authorization remains unchanged.

audit.reason: No new executable backend action is introduced.

route_guard.reason: This change hardens an action-menu permission boundary, not route access.

notes: Queued mail operations already expose a cancel action in the UI model. The action menu now treats cancel like retry: users without fair_crm.mail_send_operations.execute neither see the action nor can invoke its callback through the menu. This is a UI permission-consistency hardening only; no backend cancel endpoint is added by this change.
